svg.title: Capture, holdover and latency need separate limits
svg.desc: Synthetic mathematical illustration. See the caption and adjoining model for assumptions and interpretation.
svg.text: Capture, holdover and latency need separate limits
Noiseless sinusoidal detector: ė/k = Ω/k − sin e
For Ω/k = 0.5: filled = stable, hollow = unstable; slope is −cos e.
At Ω/k = 1 the tangent equilibrium attracts from only one side.
Holdover: fixed bounded frequency error, continuous phase; no restart
Equality at 0.127324 s; beyond it, this bound cannot support the 0.1 rad limit.
Delayed feedback: kL = π/2 is a marginal crossing, not a practical margin
Illustrative model • no measured receiver data
